item.title: Maternity Cover: Brand & Motion Designer
item.description:
About us:
Templafy started in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2014 and today brings together colleagues of 60+ nationalities in offices on several continents. We think people do their best work when they are trusted, listened to and given room to decide, and that is good for everyone. Investors have backed our product and our way of working with substantial funding.

Templafy is seeking a Brand & Motion Designer to cover a parental leave in our marketing team and help produce visual content for many channels. You enjoy explaining things clearly through design and you have animated before. Together with our creative team and the wider marketing team you will shape campaigns, keep the brand consistent everywhere and prepare assets colleagues can reuse.

This is a full-time role in our Copenhagen Office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, update and lay out guides, flyers, digital ads, web pages, social posts, sales material and event material.

  • Animate motion graphics for the website, ads and short product explainers.

  • Come up with ideas and content for the blog, advertising, campaigns and website.

  • Make clear visuals for the website, sales decks, one-page product sheets and guides.

  • Keep the brand consistent by writing and following guidelines and templates.

  • Prepare print and web files to the right specifications.

Required Qualifications:

  • Good command of Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Adobe Express, Photoshop etc.), Figma, PowerPoint and AI design tools.

  • Experience with layout, illustration and motion graphics.

  • An online portfolio of your work.

  • A careful eye for detail.

  • A good feel for designing for both screen and print.

  • Happy to work alone and with others.

  • You plan your time well and can juggle priorities.

  • Experience with infographics, data visualisation and animation.

Employee Benefits:

  • Employee share programme

  • Private health insurance

  • Lunch subsidy

  • Phone and internet paid by the company

  • Central office close to public transport

  • Company events and team outings

  • Flexible working

  • Gym membership

  • Meditation app subscription

We want a culture where curious people meet, share ideas and build things together. Good working relationships matter a lot to us, and with few layers of hierarchy, a good idea counts whoever has it.

We meet often outside of work too, from small celebrations to employee networks and shared lunches, so that people get to know each other.

We are building more than software, and we would be glad to have you along.

At Templafy everyone should feel they belong: you have a voice, you can speak up, and you will be heard. We aim for a workplace where nobody is held back because of race, colour, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, genetic information, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or any other status.

item.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
item.description:
About us:
Templafy started in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2014 and today brings together colleagues of 60+ nationalities in offices on several continents. We think people do their best work when they are trusted, listened to and given room to decide, and that is good for everyone. Investors have backed our product and our way of working with substantial funding.

About the Role

We want a practical, inventive Forward Deployed Engineer for our Technical Operations team.

You will work directly with key customers to design, build and roll out solutions that fit Templafy's platform into the way they actually work.

You will own the technical side of each project, from the first workshop through design, build and go-live, and you will build the setups, integrations and AI features their hardest document workflows need.

The role is customer-facing and sits between engineering, product and sales.

What You’ll Do

Embedded Customer Engineering
Work with customers on site or remotely to set up and connect Templafy within their document processes.

Custom Solution Development
Build customer setups from their own content, rules, integrations and data to handle demanding document cases.

Technical Discovery & Architecture Mapping
Work with Solutions Consulting and Professional Services to turn complex requirements into clear architectures and plans.

Rapid Prototyping
Build quick prototypes of integrations, document agents and automations to test fit before a full project.

Product Collaboration
Share what you learn from customers with Product Managers so the product keeps up with real needs.

Deployment & Change Management
Help customers roll out, train and adopt what you built, and hand over smoothly to their teams and our Customer Success team.

Accelerate Packaging & Repeatability
Spot patterns across projects and work with our Pricing and Packaging team to turn them into reusable solutions.

What We’re Looking For

  • A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or another technical field, or similar hands-on experience.

  • 3+ years as a Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer or a similar customer-facing technical role, ideally in enterprise SaaS or applied AI.

  • Good at uncovering business and technical needs and turning them into working solutions.

  • You notice what is missing and go and get the answers from the right people.

  • Experience with REST APIs, enterprise integrations, authentication/SSO and automation tools.

  • Curious about AI; experience building on LLM providers such as OpenAI or Anthropic is a strong plus.

  • At ease with vague problems and turning them into working software.

  • You explain technical ideas and trade-offs clearly to any audience.

  • You understand enterprise document governance and can talk confidently with senior IT leaders.

  • Deep knowledge of Microsoft Office, Word and PowerPoint in particular, and their file formats is a plus.

  • Able and willing to travel to customers when needed.

  • You act, take ownership and solve problems in a fast-moving setting.

How We’ll Measure Success

You will succeed by:

  • Finding hard document scenarios and delivering solutions customers run in production.

  • Helping customers launch their own document agents and solutions.

  • Helping us win Custom Document Agent deals.

  • Seeing end users come back to Custom Document Agents again and again.

  • Turning lessons from single customers into product improvements and reusable solutions.

Department: Technical Operations
